subject: english
stem:
Five students tried studying for twenty minutes before checking their phones. Four said they finished homework faster, while one saw no change.
Which choice is the best answer?
options: Most students in this small group reported faster homework
Phones always stop every student from learning
The study proved that phones cause all slow homework

optionRationales.reason: Most students in this small group reported faster homework：Most 與 small group 保留樣本與一人無變化的證據。
One student saw no change：只重述少數細節，漏掉主要結果。
Phones always stop every student from learning：always、every 超過五人觀察且忽略一人無變化。
The study proved that phones cause all slow homework：小型自述未證明所有作業的普遍因果。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「涵蓋全文但不加入未被原文支持的人、時間、因果或普遍結論」可推出 Most students in this small group reported faster homework；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Most students in this small group reported faster homework 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
